assertions.subject: Infectious tenosynovitis
assertions.quote: Infectious flexor tenosynovitis is an acute infection within the flexor tendon sheath.

assertions.subject: Infectious tenosynovitis
assertions.quote: can usually be differentiated from infectious flexor tenosynovitis by a more gradual onset and the absence of some of Kanavel's signs.

assertions.subject: Infectious tenosynovitis
assertions.quote: Disseminated gonococcal infection can cause tenosynovitis but often involves multiple joints

assertions.subject: Infectious tenosynovitis
assertions.quote: Infection of the tendon sheath may involve atypical mycobacteria, but these infections are usually indolent and chronic.

assertions.subject: Felon
assertions.quote: A felon is an infection of the pulp space of the fingertip, usually with staphylococci and streptococci.

assertions.subject: Palm Abscess
assertions.quote: A palm abscess is a purulent infection of deep spaces in the palm, typically with staphylococci or streptococci.
